svg.title: mla-record
svg.desc: MLA record in DeepSeek-V3: h_t (7168) is down-projected to a latent c_t of 512 and a shared RoPE key k^R of 64; only these 576 elements are cached per token and layer. Per-head keys (128 heads × 128, plus the shared 64) and values (128 × 128) are reconstructed by W_UK and W_UV and never cached. Elements per token per layer: MHA with the same shapes 40,960, GQA-8 2,048, MLA 576, K=V MQA 512. All 61 layers: 68.6 KiB per token in BF16.
